test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d49b4159f492120b14f840c0456b1042e7d72baed908c93cb39a1a6fe001a4.png]
solution:
When we compare both the figures we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d6a5534d778ad493f68f5fc5ee9a83d30cc752230d3667c353420c0421608ee.png] 

We observe that when we move the dice upwards towards right such that 5 and 2 are visible we find that on the left we have 6 and on the right we have 3 which means both are opposite to each other. So, **3 is the number on the face opposite to the face showing 6.**

Hence,** "Option 1"** is the correct answer.
